description.fun: Stakataka isn't one creature but a stack of almost 150 brick-like lifeforms that move together as one Ultra Beast. When it sleeps it plants itself on the ground and disguises itself as a stone building, and it can rearrange its bricks to grow legs strong enough to snap a tree, or open up to trap foes inside. It's the heaviest Rock-type Pokémon.
description.guide: Stakataka is a Rock- and Steel-type Ultra Beast, codenamed UB Assembly, introduced in Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon. It is made of many stone lifeforms stacked into a wall-like body, and is very sturdy but very slow. It is a version counterpart to Blacephalon.
description.tagline: A living wall made of nearly 150 brick creatures
